audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant is enforced by two bi-directional, context-independent guards: `deposit_ctoken` asserts `!self.debts.contains(CoinType)` before adding to ctokens, and `try_borrow_asset` asserts `!self.ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<MarketType, CoinType>()` before adding to debts. The flash loan hot potato (`FlashLoan<MarketType, CoinType>`) operates purely on the market reserve and grants no bypass capability to obligation guards; all obligation mutations still go through `handle_mint`/`handle_borrow` which invoke these same guarded functions.
